name: Monday Google post about food (Ember & Spice)

fields.name: Ember & Spice Grill
fields.tone_notes: Warm, friendly and family-run. We talk to customers like regulars, even on their first visit. Short, upbeat sentences with a little East London charm. One or two emojis at most. Never pushy or salesy. Always say thank you.
fields.halal_statement: All our meat is halal, certified by HMC.
fields.allergen_statement: Our kitchen handles nuts, sesame, gluten and dairy. Please tell our team about any allergy before you order.

photo_library.caption: Mixed Grill Platter on the pass
Lamb chops on the charcoal grill

recent_posts.text: Our Seekh Kebabs are minced lamb with fresh herbs and a little green chilli, flame-grilled over charcoal, two pieces for £7.95. Simple, honest grilling, just the way we like it 🙏 Come say hello this week.

Our Mixed Grill Platter is a proper feast 🔥 Lamb chops, chicken tikka, seekh kebab and wings, all flame-grilled over charcoal and served with naan and salad, just £18.50. Perfect for sharing (or not, we won't judge). Pop in tonight and dig in!
Warm kunafa with pistachio and cream, £5.95. The perfect way to finish your grill. 😋
This weekend: a free Mango Lassi with every Mixed Grill Platter. See you Saturday!
Our lamb chops are marinated overnight and flame-grilled over real charcoal. Four pieces for £13.95. Pop in tonight! 🔥

content.text: Craving a burger? Our Smash Burger is £8.95, and all our meat is halal, certified by HMC. Add Masala Chips for £3.50 and a Mango Lassi for £3.95 and you have a proper East London feast. Open today from 12pm to 11pm. Thank you for backing our family-run kitchen 🍔 Please tell our team about any allergy before you order.

checks.reason: Warm, upbeat, thanks the customer and not pushy, in line with the tone notes.
Names the Smash Burger, Masala Chips and Mango Lassi, and mentions East London and the family-run kitchen.
Plain English, short sentences, no jargon.
Opening and closing differ from the last posts. A burger post is also a new topic.
No em-dashes. One emoji, within the limit of 2 for posts. No hashtags. No banned words such as 'cheap'.
Menu, halal statement, allergen statement and hours all trace to resolved sources. 'Family-run' comes from the tone notes. 'East London' fits the Whitechapel address.
£8.95, £3.50 and £3.95 match the menu exactly.
Today is Monday 12 October 2026 and Monday hours are 12:00 to 23:00, so 'Open today from 12pm to 11pm' is correct.
Smash Burger, Masala Chips and Mango Lassi match the menu names.
No causal claims.
The halal claim matches the profile: all meat halal, certified by HMC. The allergy line points people to staff and makes no safety claim.
No offer or discount. The items are listed at their menu prices, with no bundle price or urgency.
No targeting by personal traits.
Nothing offered in exchange for a review.
No personal data and no photo of people.
No financial, tax, legal or staffing advice.
No phone number in the post text. The Call button is used.
No maker rules are broken. Claims come from the profile, there are no em-dashes, the emoji is allowed, and the topic is not repeated within 3 weeks.
Renders as a standard Ember & Spice Grill Google update card. No brand kit was supplied to compare against, and nothing looks off.
No photo is attached to this post.
Text fits the card cleanly on mobile and the Call button is visible.
No placeholders, empty slots or broken elements.
